PLAN "Perimenopause Bone-Loading Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build bone density and preserve lean mass via heavy compound lifting"
  GOAL secondary general_fitness:
    name "Maintain cardiovascular health with heat-managed conditioning"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Accumulation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower body - squat focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
          goblet_squat 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper body - press focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
          band_pull_apart_substitute face_pull 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Lower body - deadlift focus":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          cat_cow 1m
          bird_dog 1m
          glute_bridge 2m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          pigeon_pose 2m
          child_pose 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Aerobic - cool environment":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 30m
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          calf_stretch 1m
